broeringluke: Roland "Doc" Broeringluke arrived on Day 5 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
frank_mart00: At the depot, Matthias Mart had practised answering to his name. At R-F7, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

A child had enclosed a riddle in a parcel for Matthias Mart. The answer was on the back. He kept the dugout guessing until supper. Verdel Ridge has been won. Matthias Mart listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Matthias Mart asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.

On a quiet night Matthias Mart (Concord) and Ulrich Jwessels (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there. A letter from home found Matthias Mart before the night shift. Matthias Mart folded it small and kept it close.
lancegribko: The old hands of R-F22 have been here since Day 1. Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko has been here since Day 4. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Clement "Hollow" Lancegribko gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
owenhart247: Felix "Bones" Owenhart reached S-F13 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.
Felix "Bones" Owenhart was in the first hundred. The old hands in S-F13 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
Felix "Bones" Owenhart sharpened a pencil with great care and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.
Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord at dusk. Felix "Bones" Owenhart helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Felix "Bones" Owenhart fired at a movement across the wire at S-F13. The man went down: Florian "Shadow" Slightlyreta, badly wounded.

Felix "Bones" Owenhart was hit through the chest at S-F13. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Severin Heheheha of the Hegemony (@heheheha1939). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Felix "Bones" Owenhart fell at S-F13 and never moved again. Shot by Severin Heheheha of the Hegemony (@heheheha1939).

The papers connected Edmund Owenhart to Felix "Bones" Owenhart. The men took longer to learn Edmund Owenhart's own habits, but they made the effort. Volunteer number 75. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Edmund Owenhart's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
schradog2: Casimir Schradog arrived with the Day 3 draft, carrying his mother's thimble and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it. Verdel Ridge is in Concord hands. Casimir Schradog stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.
Casimir Schradog polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.

Casimir Schradog borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'. A letter from home reached Casimir Schradog before dusk. Casimir Schradog read it twice and slept a little easier.
